title: P&G partners with McLaren F1 team to drive Asia-Pacific engagement
summary: Activations during the motorsport will centre on P&G brands, such as Head & Shoulders and Oral B, as part of the partnership with reigning Formula 1 team winners McLaren, whose drivers include reigning World Drivers’ Champion Lando Norris

extraction.key_fact: 피앤지가 아시아 태평양 지역 공략 강화를 위해 맥라렌 포뮬러 원 팀과 파트너십을 체결했다.
